A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Twi'lek''' [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]] and some other [[Fringer/Legends|fringers]] accompanied the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] to [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Bossk was hired by [[Dominic Raynor]], the former owner of the [[City/Legends|settlement]], to capture or [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. Calrissian had won the city from Raynor in a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]], but the former owner accused him of cheating. Under Bossk's leadership, his party infiltrated the city and set up an [[Ambush in Cloud City|ambush]] for Calrissian on one of the maintenance levels. Although the Baron Administrator was lured to the site and immediately came under attack by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] and his companions, he fled the ambush through a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] with the help of his [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|guards]].

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] worked as a [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]]<ref name="SWM" /> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="date">The ''[[Sore Loser's Revenge]]'' scenario does not provide a time frame for Bossk's ambush, in which the Twi'lek was present, but the comic [[Lady Luck (comic story)|''Lady Luck'']] states that Calrissian won Cloud City in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. Furthermore, the short story ''[[Lando Calrissian: Idiot's Array]]'', which describes Raynor's last assassination attempt against Calrissian happening around six weeks after the sabacc match, reveals that the ambush happens within these six weeks.</ref> In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the former [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] [[Dominic Raynor]] lost his [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[City/Legends|settlement]] in a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] against the professional [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. Raynor accused his rival of cheating and thus hired the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] to capture or [[Death/Legends|kill]] Calrissian as part of Raynor's revenge. With the knowledge that Calrissian would be hard to capture, Bossk contacted some [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and [[Assassin/Legends|cutthroats]] and invited the Twi'lek, [[Unidentified Twi'lek 1 (Ambush in Cloud City)|another scoundrel]] of the same [[Species/Legends|species]], a [[Unidentified Duros (Ambush in Cloud City)|Duros mercenary]], and a [[Unidentified Quarren (Ambush in Cloud City)|Quarren assassin]] to join the hunt.<ref name="SLR" />

The Twi'lek and his companions planned an [[Ambush in Cloud City|ambush]] to capture Calrissian on one of the city's maintenance level. Bossk hacked into the communications system of the city and impersonated the city's [[Cloud City chief engineer|chief engineer]] to inform Calrissian that a primary [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] pod was about to break down&mdash;a failure that would destroy the entire floating settlement. In response, Calrissian went to the maintenance level to check the pod in the company of his [[Unidentified Twi'lek bodyguard|Twi'lek bodyguard]] and four [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guards]], who came along as a precautionary measure.<ref name="SLR" />

Bossk instructed his companions to stay under cover but remain in sight to lure Calrissian out. Unsure of which [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] Calrissian would use, the Twi'lek and the others spread out into each room near the lifts. When Calrissian and his [[Bodyguard/Legends|guard]] entered the maintenance level, a [[Blast door/Legends|blast door]] was shut behind them, and the ad hoc hunting party opened [[Blaster/Legends|fire]] on the Baron Administrator's guards in an attempt to kill them off quickly and capture Calrissian alive. With a long [[Dagger/Legends|dagger]], the Twi'lek attacked his opponents, who decided to hold their enemies off in order to win time for Calrissian to escape through a nearby [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]. A member of Calrissian's party sent a distress call, and another quartet of Wing Guards arrived to assist the Baron Administrator, who managed to escape from the fracas.<ref name="SLR" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TwilekScoundrel-SWM.jpg|thumb|right|100px|The Twi'lek scoundrel's figurine]]
The Twi'lek appeared in ''[[Sore Loser's Revenge]]'', a [[Wizards.com]] online [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] scenario written by [[Eric Cagle]] for the ''[[Star Wars Miniatures]]'' collectible tabletop strategy game in [[2004]]. He was represented by a generic Twi'lek Scoundrel miniature figurine<ref name="SLR" /> from the ''Miniatures'' set [[Rebel Storm (Star Wars Miniatures)|''Rebel Storm'']].<ref name="SWM" /> The survival of the character depends on the players' actions. During the game, the players control every character; one plays Calrissian's [[Squad/Legends|squad]], and the opponent plays Bossk's squad, including the Twi'lek. There is an alternate ending to the scenario, in which the Twi'lek's party defeats the Baron Administrator's escorts and captures Calrissian.<ref name="SLR" /> However, the short story ''[[Lando Calrissian: Idiot's Array]]'' has rendered this ending [[Canon|non-canonical]] by featuring Calrissian unharmed and free only a few days after Bossk's ambush.<ref name="idiot">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/fiction/f20080522/index.html|text="Lando Calrissian: Idiot's Array"|int=Lando Calrissian: Idiot's Array|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref>
